articles.title: MoneyGram joins Solana as validator amid stablecoin payment push
articles.snippet: The remittances firm has become a validator on the Solana blockchain, helping process and secure transactions as it expands its stablecoin payments strategy.

articles.title: Bitcoin tipped for $66K top as trader flags 'suspicious' BTC price gains
articles.snippet: Bitcoin pushed for a $64,000 reclaim despite the US-Iran war making a partial comeback and Binance spot sellers keeping up pressure from earlier in the week.

articles.title: Dash eyes Philippines as market for crypto payments
articles.snippet: Dash is assessing the Philippines for a crypto payments push as regulators promote easier business registration, though industry participants say compliant market entry can still take years.

articles.title: Bitcoin rotations into altcoins collapse: Have altseasons 'disappeared'?
articles.snippet: BTC's crypto market dominance is holding above a key support, signaling Bitcoin may keep absorbing capital from altcoins and delay a broader altseason.

articles.title: Google Warns AI Consciousness Debate Could Become a Political Battleground
articles.snippet: A new paper from Google DeepMind argues that disagreements over whether AI is conscious could spill into politics, law, and public institutions.
